title: Political Extremism and Post-Purchase Customer–Brand Relationships
authors: Forrest V. Morgeson, Udit Sharma, Yuyuan (Hana) Pan, G. Tomas M. Hult, Ayalla A. Ruvio, Shana L. Redd

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: Political Extremism and Post-Purchase Customer–Brand Relationships

eligible_reason: Cross-sectional regressions on ACSI customer survey data 2016-2021 (Study 1, proprietary, restricted) with brand, industry, year and month FE and a continuous political-extremism regressor, plus online experiments (Studies 2A-4B and WA studies). No DiD.
design_notes: Study 1 code and data marked 'NOT FOR PUBLIC' are restricted (not requested). 10 public do-files and .dta files for the experiments.
data_provenance_note: Experimental data shipped; Study 1 survey data restricted.
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract, README and do-files.
main_text_note: AAM checked: Study 1 pools ACSI customer survey responses 2016-2021 (repeated cross-sections) and regresses repurchase likelihood and price insensitivity on continuous political extremism with brand, industry, year and month FE and moderators (Table 3); a control-function approach addresses endogeneity. Continuous regressor, no treatment timing; not DiD.
